verify_detail: l-looking nondeterministic app state. The UI test\'s assertion that "Retry sync" is visible is only valid when the app cold-starts into the "Sync idle" state; it will legitimately fail whenever the app starts in "Sync unavailable" (~35-40% of cold launches in this sample). To de-flake, the test needs to either force/mock a deterministic sync state before asserting, or first assert on which "Sync status" value appeared and branch/skip the "Retry sync" visibility check for the "unavailable" case.'
